description: Consumer Affairs Authority  -    Order to remove the item "Coconut"  in Ex. Gaz. No. 2048/30 dated 06.12.2017
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, specifically removing an item ("Coconut") from a previous order. This constitutes a regulatory action and modification of existing regulations, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
